name: Marriott Bonvoy Boundless® Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable APRs from Chase pricing terms; purchase APR varies based on creditworthiness and Prime Rate.

categories.label: Combined grocery stores, gas stations, and dining purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Points transfer to Marriott Bonvoy after each billing cycle; points do not expire with card earning activity or other qualifying Marriott Bonvoy activity every 24 months.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 125,000 bonus points plus 1 Free Night Award after spending $3,000 on eligible purchases within 3 months of account opening.

benefits.title: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.description: Free Night Award each year after account anniversary, valid for a one-night hotel stay at a property with a redemption level up to 35,000 points; resort fees may apply.

benefits.title: Limited-time airline statement credits
benefits.description: New cardmembers who apply during the Chase promotional period can earn up to $100 in statement credits after qualifying eligible airline purchases.

benefits.title: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Silver Elite Status each calendar year as a cardmember, subject to account and Marriott Bonvoy terms.

benefits.title: 15 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: Receive 15 Elite Night Credits toward Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status each calendar year, subject to program restrictions.

benefits.title: 1 Elite Night Credit for every $5,000 spent
benefits.description: Earn 1 Elite Night Credit toward Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status for each $5,000 in eligible purchases.

benefits.title: Path to Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Earn Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status after spending $35,000 on purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Travel and purchase coverage
benefits.description: Includes baggage delay insurance, lost luggage reimbursement, trip delay reimbursement, and purchase protection when eligible terms are met.

benefits.title: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Complimentary DashPass for 12 months when activated with the card during the Chase promotional period; terms apply.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite Status; path to Gold Elite Status after $35,000 in purchases each calendar year.
other: Annual Free Night Award up to 35,000 points
15 Elite Night Credits each calendar year
Up to 17x total points at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels when including Marriott Bonvoy member and Silver Elite earnings

notes: Offers, APRs, and benefit terms can change; verified against Chase pages on last_verified date.
